versions.subject: Merge PR #4830 from @frack113 - Enhance Wbadmin based rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'WBADMIN.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' recovery'
        - 'recoveryTarget'
        - 'itemtype:File'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\wbadmin.exe" OR OriginalFileName="WBADMIN.EXE" CommandLine="* recovery*" CommandLine="*recoveryTarget*" CommandLine="*itemtype:File*"
